workItem: Isolate independent read-only GitHub evidence stages so an Enterprise license-read failure cannot suppress the Enterprise Actions settings inventory, while preserving an overall failing workflow conclusion.
workItemDE: Unabhängige read-only GitHub-Evidence-Stufen isolieren, damit ein Fehler beim Enterprise-Lizenz-Read das Enterprise-Actions-Settings-Inventar nicht unterdrückt und der Gesamtworkflow Fehler weiterhin wahrheitsgemäß als FAIL meldet.
priorityReason: Run #35988980160 proved that a 403 in Enterprise license attribution aborts before the settings inventory can validate the newly configured Enterprise token.
scopeBoundary: Read-only workflow control-flow hardening only; no GitHub provider setting mutation.
No secret/token value export, persistence or scope expansion.
Independent read stages may continue after peer-stage failure, but the final workflow result remains FAIL when any required evidence stage fails.
exitEvidence: Run #35988980160 remains recorded as the reproducer: Enterprise license read returned HTTP 403 before settings inventory execution.
Each independent read stage exposes its original step outcome.
A final completion gate fails the job if any required read stage outcome is not success.
Cleanup remains if: always() and removes runner-temporary secret/evidence files.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
